environments: one same-job hosted Linux x64 diagnostic

pairs.extension: Only if any target paired-median bootstrap interval includes the 1.15 boundary after five pairs; no second extension

process.warmStatistic: median of three warm suite timings per independent process; retain all three
process.firstMeaning: first canonical suite after module loading, fixture hashing and canonical lossless reference preparation; not OS-cold I/O or process startup latency

statistics.paired: B/A for each pair; first and warm separate
statistics.summary: all raw timings, paired ratios, median, min/max, MAD
statistics.interval: seeded percentile bootstrap of the paired median, 20000 resamples, 95% interval; exploratory small-sample uncertainty only
statistics.pass: all three targets in both phases have upper interval <= 1.15; all output and quality contracts match
statistics.inconclusive: interval still overlaps 1.15 at ten pairs or any unaccounted contract/measurement defect

outputs: Every sampled output records bytes, SHA256, decoded dimensions/format/metadata; A/B hashes and existing quality axes must match. No output policy/quality/security changes.
build: npm ci and npm run build per isolated checkout; Rust 1.88.0 release lto/codegen-units=1/opt-level=3/strip; distinct Cargo targets; dependency cache shared only for downloads

local.cpu: Mac16,10; 10 physical CPUs; no thermal/frequency guarantee

limits: Original hosted single-shot values cannot prove causal regression.
Historical CPU contention and original binary hashes are unknown unless retained logs supply them.
No p90 or universal production performance claim from five or ten pairs.
No favorable-run selection, threshold changes, baseline overwrite or case removal.
